description: Digital Detox Music | Surbahar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of deep Indian classical surbahar to switch your mind off the feed.
Put the phone face-down. Ninety minutes of slow, resonant surbahar in Raga Khamaj — deep, spacious, and completely offline — to let an overstimulated mind come back to itself.
🎧 HOW TO USE — screen away, volume low. For the hour after work, an evening off the feed, or any time your attention feels shredded.
⏱ BEST FOR — digital detox · doomscrolling recovery · attention reset · evening unplugging · deep calm
🎵 ABOUT — the surbahar is the deep bass sitar of Indian classical music, built for slowness the internet never allows; Raga Khamaj is the light, warm raga of easeful evenings.
